newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products start steady to soft.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products start steady to soft.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to soft on Wednesday morning, gas oil felled by futures, while fuel oil barges were broadly unchanged, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were off by $2 a tonne as IPE futures reacted to weak U.S. stocks data. Offers for prompt material remained at around IPE May +$1 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil barge offers held at $83 fob Rotterdam. Bids, however, were $1 down on Tuesday's closing levels, at $81 fob.
Initial bunker enquiry levels were moderate.
